meta.subtitle: 7+ Years | Tabular ML → Computer Vision → LLM Application → Generative AI

summary: I find problems no one has defined yet and turn them into products that deliver business results.

Seven years leading AI products and teams across fintech AutoML, medical AI, commerce AIaaS, and generative AI video. I act as a translator between technology, market, and organization, and I make the case with working demos rather than words. I align product teams with the company's vision and OKRs and stay accountable until the goals are met.

highlights: Developed a Product Pivot strategy in response to technology and market trends, leading the transition from a 3D product to a generative AI web platform that officially launched in July 2026.

Implemented the LLM-to-Unreal E2E integration for a LangChain-based Film Agent and took responsibility for planning and developing context management for entire productions after the web product launched.

Personally prototyped and validated technical demos to address Post Production problems when using generative AI, then handed them over to the development organization for integration into the product.
Supported six user studies and two additional model integrations over five months through an internally built motion evaluation platform.
Formed the web team’s AI Literacy TF and redesigned the core user flow; after the web team implemented it in two weeks, production A/B testing showed a 2.8x clip-download conversion rate.
Planned and launched a Long→Short-form AI editor and a shopping assistant chatbot from 0→1.
Established AIaaS product, pricing, contracting, and operating frameworks, leading business-wide MRR growth from KRW 5M to 52M in one year.
Led technical discussions, PoCs, and contract negotiations after initial meetings, securing 12 new clients.
Built and led the AIaaS organization from 0→20 people, with responsibility for overall OKRs and the hiring, personnel management, and performance reviews of four PMs.
Applied LLMs to automate manual work in developing HR competency assessment tasks and improved operations to support the family business’s turnaround.
Created initial product plans and PRDs for HER2 and ER/PR biomarker analysis products and supported FDA and CE documentation preparation for existing products.
